book.title: 睡不着的午休小床
book.subtitle: 安静地躺一会儿，身体也在充电

moral.zh: 睡不着也没关系；闭上眼睛轻轻呼吸，身体就会慢慢积蓄起下午的活力。
moral.en: It is okay if sleep does not come right away; resting quietly with closed eyes still recharges our body with energy.

pages.zhText: 午饭后，大班的教室拉上了厚厚的鹅黄色遮光窗帘，屋子里一下子变成了柔和温暖的黄昏模样。
pages.enText: After lunch, the senior classroom drew its thick honey-yellow curtains, turning the room into a cozy twilight space.

pages.enText: The room grew quiet. A nearby child turned over and soon fell asleep. Another hugged a teddy bear, breathing softly.

pages.zhText: 可是，安安睁着大大的眼睛，盯着天花板上的吊扇发呆。她一点儿睡意也没有，脑子里特别清醒。
pages.enText: Yet An'an's eyes were wide open, gazing up at the ceiling fan. She didn't feel sleepy at all; her mind felt completely wide awake.

pages.enText: An'an rolled to her side, and the wooden cot creaked softly. In the quiet room, the noise felt huge, making her freeze in place.

pages.zhText: “大家都睡着了，只有我不睡觉，老师会不会觉得我是个不听话的坏孩子？”安安心里像揣了一只小兔子般不安。
pages.enText: “Everyone is asleep except me. Will the teacher think I'm being naughty?” An'an worried, her heart fluttering nervously.

pages.zhText: 为了快点睡着，安安紧紧闭上眼睛，在心里默念数羊：“一只羊、两只羊、三只羊……”可数到了一百只，还是醒着的。
pages.enText: To fall asleep faster, An'an squeezed her eyes shut and counted sheep: “One sheep, two sheep, three sheep...” But at one hundred, she was still awake.

pages.zhText: 她越是逼着自己睡觉，太阳穴就越是跳得欢，甚至觉得小枕头有点硬邦邦的，被窝里也有点热烘烘的。
pages.enText: The harder she forced herself, the more her temples throbbed; the pillow felt stiff and the blanket uncomfortably warm.

pages.zhText: 安安吓得赶紧把眼睛闭得死死的，假装已经睡熟了。但她微微颤抖的长睫毛把秘密全都透露了。
pages.enText: An'an quickly clamped her eyes shut, pretending to be fast asleep. But her fluttering eyelashes gave her secret away.

pages.zhText: 安安慢慢睁开眼睛，难过地小声说：“老师……我努力数了一百只羊，可我还是睡不着。”
pages.enText: An'an opened her eyes slowly, whispering with shame: “Teacher... I counted a hundred sheep, but I just can't sleep.”

pages.zhText: “现在还没睡着，也没有关系。”林老师在床边坐下，轻轻地说，“你不需要假装。”
pages.enText: “It is all right that you are still awake,” Teacher Lin whispered, sitting beside the bed. “You do not need to pretend.”

pages.zhText: “小身体有时候像一块充满电的小电池，不一定每次都需要关机睡着。”老师帮她把被角塞得平平整整。
pages.enText: “Sometimes our body is like a fully charged battery; it doesn't need to shut down every afternoon,” the teacher smoothed the quilt.

pages.enText: “Just resting with eyes closed gives little legs and eyes a holiday. Listening to leaves rustling still recharges you,” she said.

pages.zhText: 安安心里那块沉甸甸的石头放下了。她不再使劲闭眼，只是舒服地躺着，听窗外很轻的声音。
pages.enText: The weight in An'an's heart lifted. She stopped squeezing her eyes shut and rested comfortably, listening to the soft sounds outside.

pages.zhText: 这一次，安安后来睡着了。也许另一天，她只安静地休息。无论哪一种，老师都愿意陪她找到舒服的办法。
pages.enText: This time, An'an fell asleep later. Another day, she might simply rest quietly. Either way, her teacher would help her feel comfortable.

parentGuide.goal: 卸除大班孩子在集体午休中“非睡不可”的焦虑，学会不打扰他人的安静独处与身体放松。
parentGuide.reminder: 承认大班儿童睡眠需求存在个体差异，不以“必须入睡”作为乖巧标准，允许静卧休息。
questions: 安安睡不着的时候，心里在担心什么？
就算没有睡着，闭上眼睛躺着有什么好处？
parentGuide.activity: 和孩子一起体验 3 分钟“静音听风”呼吸游戏：闭上眼睛，数出房间里能听到的三种细微声音。

ageTips.age4to5: 允许孩子用指图、点头、手势等非语言方式表达；共读以倾听、感受安抚为主，不强求马上做到。
ageTips.age6to8: 讨论大班一日生活中的真实感受与解决策略，鼓励孩子自己提出小行动，家长承担托底支持与陪伴责任。
